facts.business: Sharvaya Metals Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of value-added aluminium products including alloyed ingots, billets, slabs, sheets, circles, and specialised solutions such as EV battery housings, serving industries such as electric vehicles, construction, defence, automotive, aviation, consumer appliances, cookware, and LED lighting.
